findings.message: contains 2 line(s) longer than 500 characters (possible minified/obfuscated code)
findings.remediation: Review extremely long lines; they may contain hidden logic.
findings.impact: Extremely long lines hide obfuscated or minified code from human review.
findings.attack_vector: Lines > 500 chars — code is structured to evade visual inspection.
findings.risk_adjustment: No automatic downgrade: risk changes require explicit protective controls.

findings.message: contains Unicode bidirectional or zero-width control characters (2 occurrences in this file)
findings.remediation: Remove hidden Unicode controls from source and review the affected lines for Trojan Source substitutions.
findings.impact: Hidden Unicode controls can make reviewers see a different control flow than the compiler parses.
findings.attack_vector: Bidirectional or zero-width characters are embedded in source identifiers, strings, or comments.
findings.risk_adjustment: No automatic downgrade: risk changes require explicit protective controls.

findings.message: dependency dsh-voice-core uses an unpinned git URL
findings.remediation: Pin all dependencies to immutable commit SHAs or version ranges.
findings.impact: Unpinned git/URL dependencies allow attackers to publish malicious versions at any time.
findings.attack_vector: Dependency resolves to a mutable ref (branch/tag) — attacker pushes a malicious commit to the ref.
findings.risk_adjustment: No automatic downgrade: risk changes require explicit protective controls.
